text: Reach people: users, advisors and research partners

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Moonshot engine makes human intent the strategic layer for increasingly capable AI.
A shared ideation graph for a real group of people is the cooperation engine in its simplest live form.

Researchers working on human oversight of agents value pre-registered runs with negative results kept; a public note gets at least one substantive outside response (comment, citation, contact) within 6 weeks of publishing. Refuted if it gets none.

Two outside people who think about explicit claims and human judgment can tell within one conversation whether the idea graph's hypotheses/reflections are a format others can use, which no internal test can show.

ARIA names 'requirement capture' and 'users' preferences' as missing agent infrastructure, which is the cooperation engine's core claim stated by an outside funder; a reviewer's response tests whether outsiders see the idea graph that way.
